description: This file manages rules and workflows for a VSCode extension, including enabling/disabling rules, creating/deleting rule files, and handling rule directories.

methods.name: getEnabledRules
methods.description: Retrieves enabled rules and workflows from specified directories based on user toggles.

methods.name: getEnabledRulesFromDirectory
methods.description: Reads a directory and returns a set of enabled rules based on allowed extensions and toggle states.

methods.name: toggleWorkflow
methods.description: Enables or disables a workflow, updating global or local state accordingly.

methods.name: toggleRule
methods.description: Enables or disables a rule, updating global or local state accordingly.

methods.name: getRuleDirectoryPath
methods.description: Returns the directory path for rules or workflows based on base directory and type.

methods.name: createRuleFile
methods.description: Creates a new rule or workflow file with a template, ensuring no overwrite occurs.

methods.name: workflowTemplate
methods.description: Generates a template string for a workflow rule file.

methods.name: ruleTemplate
methods.description: Generates a template string for a rule file.

methods.name: deleteRuleFile
methods.description: Deletes a rule file after user confirmation.
